FN-0F21C6-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 375
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Matt Simpson
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 04/27/2023
House Bill 375as introduced would decrease receipts to the following funds by the following
estimated annual amounts by exempting sales for gun safes and safety devices from state, county, and
municipal sales and use tax:
Education Trust Fund ($ 577,000)
County Funds ($ 144,000)
Municipal Funds ($ 577,000)
TOTAL ($ 1,298,000)
Pursuant to the provisions of the ETF Rolling Reserve Act contained in Section 29-9-3(b)(3),
Code of Alabama 1975, the provisions of this bill will reduce the ETF fiscal year appropriation
cap for fiscal year 2024 by $577,000.
Page 1
